subject: Re: US vs CAD Pricing Question

messages.subject: US vs CAD Pricing Question
messages.text:
Hi again, 
 

 I just realized your insulated jacket is 199 USD but 299 Canadian. Shouldn't it be around 270 Canadian with the current conversion rate? Why are Canadians charged more for the same product? 
 

 -Courtney Belyea

messages.subject: Re: US vs CAD Pricing Question
messages.text:
Hello Courtney,
 

 Usually, we charge more to US customers (+22%) for the same product. The only exception is the milkweed jackets. We tried lowering the price manually to see if we could get more traction for this products, and also because of now high tariffs, which we make the US customers pay.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay
